domains.name: Transparent Lottery
domains.promise: Members buy play-money lottery tickets per guild with /lottery buy, each ticket grows one shared jackpot, and an always-on schedule draws a single stable winner who is paid the whole play-money pot exactly once — a draw that fires with no tickets cancels and resets the pot with no coins ever trapped, ticket buys are atomic and fully refunded on failure, and every reward and cost stays inside the fake game economy and never touches real commerce.

controls.description: Master switch for the lottery; when off, the draw schedule stops and /lottery commands explain the feature is disabled.
Play-money coin cost of one lottery ticket, read from economy_lottery_ticket_price.
Conservative per-member wager cap: the maximum tickets one member may hold in a single drawing, read from economy_lottery_max_tickets.
How often the always-on scheduler draws a winner, read from economy_lottery_schedule.

defaults.rationale: A transparent jackpot is a flagship game-economy loop and ships on for the maximal out-of-box experience.
A light, approachable play-coin entry price that keeps a jackpot meaningful without pricing out casual members.
A conservative default wager cap so no single member can run away with the odds; fully owner-tunable.
A weekly cadence gives the pot time to build into an exciting prize while guaranteeing a regular payout.

permissions.enforcement: Lottery slash commands respond for every member; /lottery buy only ever debits the invoking member's own wallet and adds tickets under the invoking member's own id.

permissions.actor: Dashboard user with owner or admin access to the guild
permissions.action: Edit lottery settings on the dashboard economy lottery page
permissions.enforcement: Dashboard session auth plus Supabase RLS restrict guild_config writes to authorized guild administrators.

permissions.action: Trigger a lottery draw, pick the winner, or reassign the jackpot
permissions.enforcement: There is no member-facing draw command; draws run only on the always-on scheduler, and the winner is selected and stored atomically by lottery_claim_drawing with no code path letting a member influence it.

messages.trigger: A member buys lottery tickets with play-money coins
messages.audience: The buying member and the channel
messages.defaultTemplate: You're in, {member-name}! {ticket-count} ticket(s) bought for {total-cost} play coins — the jackpot is now {jackpot} play coins.

messages.trigger: A scheduled draw resolves with at least one ticket sold
messages.surface: Announcement embed in the configured lottery log channel
messages.audience: The winner and the whole guild
messages.defaultTemplate: The draw is in! {winner-mention} wins the {jackpot}-play-coin jackpot on ticket #{winning-number}. A fresh lottery is open — grab tickets with /lottery buy.

messages.trigger: A scheduled draw fires with no tickets sold
messages.surface: Announcement embed in the configured lottery log channel
messages.defaultTemplate: No tickets this time — the lottery pot has been reset. Buy tickets with /lottery buy to kick off the next one!

messages.trigger: The atomic ticket-buy RPC fails after the wallet debit, or the drawing closed for its draw between checkout and the row lock
messages.surface: Ephemeral reply to the invoking member
messages.defaultTemplate: That ticket purchase didn't go through, {member-name} — your {total-cost} play coins are already back in your wallet.

messages.trigger: The lottery backend is temporarily unreachable when a member runs a lottery command
messages.surface: Ephemeral reply to the invoking member
messages.defaultTemplate: The lottery booth is catching its breath, {member-name} — give it a moment and try /lottery again.

messages.trigger: A scheduled draw's payout keeps failing or a stuck drawing had to be recovered
messages.defaultTemplate: Heads up: a lottery draw needs a hand — the {jackpot}-play-coin drawing hit a snag and is queued for automatic retry. Nothing was double-paid and everything is logged.

values.description: No active drawing exists in this guild; /lottery view invites the first buy, which opens a fresh drawing.
An active drawing exists; members buy tickets, each atomic buy grows the shared jackpot, and the scheduler will draw when the interval elapses.
The scheduler claimed the drawing and stored its single stable winner; the jackpot payout is pending and retried until it lands exactly once.
The stored winner has been paid the whole jackpot exactly once and the drawing is finalised as drawn.
A draw fired with no tickets; the drawing was cancelled under its row lock and the pot reset, with no coins trapped.
Lottery disabled by configuration; no draw schedule runs and /lottery commands explain the feature is off.

transitions.trigger: A member runs /lottery buy and ensureActiveDrawing creates the guild's active drawing
transitions.expectedEffect: Exactly one active economy_lottery_drawings row is created and the first atomic ticket buy debits the member and seeds the jackpot.

transitions.trigger: A member runs /lottery buy with sufficient play-money balance
transitions.expectedEffect: lottery_buy_tickets locks the drawing, enforces the per-member max, inserts the tickets, and increments the jackpot in one transaction; a failed buy is fully refunded.

transitions.trigger: The scheduled interval elapses with tickets sold and lottery_claim_drawing claims the row
transitions.expectedEffect: The drawing flips active to drawing while atomically picking and persisting the single winning ticket, so the winner is stable across retries.

transitions.trigger: lottery_award_jackpot credits the stored winner and finalises the drawing
transitions.expectedEffect: The whole jackpot lands in the stored winner's wallet exactly once, the row becomes drawn, and the branded win announcement posts.

transitions.trigger: The scheduler finds a legacy drawing stuck in drawing with a NULL winner from a mid-claim crash
transitions.expectedEffect: The guarded single-statement update reverts the row to active so it re-enters the normal pipeline; because a NULL winner proves no payout ever happened, this is double-pay-safe.

transitions.trigger: The scheduled interval elapses with no tickets sold
transitions.expectedEffect: lottery_cancel_drawing_if_empty re-checks emptiness under the row lock and cancels in the same transaction; any buy that raced the cancel is fully refunded, so no coins are trapped.
No active drawing remains; the next /lottery buy opens a fresh one with the jackpot reset to zero.

transitions.trigger: The cancelled empty drawing is retired
transitions.expectedEffect: No active drawing remains; the next /lottery buy opens a fresh one with the jackpot reset to zero.

transitions.trigger: Owner turns lottery-enabled off on the dashboard
transitions.expectedEffect: The draw schedule stops and /lottery commands reply with the disabled explanation; the drawing and ticket rows are preserved untouched.
The scheduler resumes on the configured interval and the next /lottery buy opens a fresh drawing with all prior history intact.

failures.trigger: lottery_buy_tickets fails after economy_subtract_balance debited, or the drawing was claimed or cancelled between checkout and the RPC's row lock
failures.expectedBehavior: The entire buy transaction rolls back so no tickets are inserted and the jackpot is unchanged, the debited coins are refunded exactly once through economy_add_balance, and the member is told plainly their coins are back — never charged for unwinnable or unrecorded tickets.

failures.trigger: lottery_award_jackpot fails after lottery_claim_drawing stored the winning ticket
failures.expectedBehavior: The drawing stays in drawing with its single stored winner recorded, the next scheduler tick retries the SAME winner, and the jackpot is paid exactly once — never re-rolled to a different winner and never double-paid.

failures.trigger: The Supabase dependency is unreachable when a member runs /lottery buy or view, or when a scheduled draw tick runs
failures.expectedBehavior: Commands reply with the branded lottery-unavailable message and no coins move, the draw tick logs and skips without crashing the bot, and the next tick retries; no ticket, jackpot, or payout is applied twice.
